title: Security of LLM systems & agents
question: Can untrusted information redirect an AI system?
description: We study indirect prompt injection end to end: from getting malicious content retrieved to compromising retrieval-augmented generation and agent workflows.

title: AI provenance & model accountability
question: Can we trace AI-generated text and detect how it is reused?
description: We develop watermarks for text provenance and model distillation detection, and evaluate their robustness to removal and changes to the model.

title: Privacy auditing & data protection
question: What can models reveal about the data they learn from or process?
description: We audit training-data membership, study image-input leakage in distributed multimodal inference, and design private text synthesis without a trusted curator.

title: Fairness & robust collaborative learning
question: When does learning amplify bias, and how can collaboration be more robust?
description: We examine the effects of training randomness, federated collaboration, adversarial manipulation, and fairness constraints on equity, robustness, and privacy.
